# Kevin Okhuysen — Okhuysen Dev

> Full Stack Developer based in Tijuana, Baja California, México. Builds websites, web apps, and mobile apps for medical, dental, industrial, consulting, and commerce businesses. Works remotely with clients in Mexico and the United States, in Spanish and English.

## Tech stack

Astro, Next.js, React, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, Python, Kotlin, Swift, MySQL, Firebase, Supabase, Stripe, QuickBooks, Cloudflare, Android Studio, Git, GitHub, Vercel, Netlify.

## Services

- Websites and landing pages (SEO/AEO, multi-language)
- Web apps and custom systems (dashboards, admin systems, bookings)
- Mobile apps (Android, iOS)
- E-commerce and payments (Stripe)
- Analytics and performance (Google Analytics, Tag Manager, Meta Pixel)
